title: CustomPrefixGUI
description: A lightweight Paper plugin that lets players create custom gradient prefixes through a simple in-game GUI.
body:
**CustomPrefixGUI** is a lightweight and modern Paper plugin that allows players to create and apply custom gradient prefixes directly in-game through an intuitive GUI.

With a simple `/customprefix` command, players can open a clean two-step menu where they can enter a custom prefix (up to 12 characters) and choose from 20 built-in gradient styles. A live preview is shown inside the GUI, so players can see exactly how their prefix will look before saving it.

Once applied, the prefix appears in bold with a smooth gradient effect in chat and player display names, giving your server a stylish and polished look without any complex setup.

✨ Features

* Simple in-game GUI-based prefix editor
* 20 gradient styles to choose from
* Live preview before applying changes
* Bold gradient prefixes shown in chat and name
* Lightweight and performance-friendly
* Configurable cooldown and word filter

🔐 Permissions

* `customprefix.use` — Allows access to `/customprefix`

⚙️ Requirements

* Paper 1.21.x (Java 21)

CustomPrefixGUI is designed to be easy to use, visually clean, and fully compatible with permission systems like LuckPerms.
